White]] |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |release date=[[September 9]], [[2015]]{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/52678/journey_to_star_wars_the_force_awakens_-_shattered_empire_2015_1|text=Journey To Star Wars: The Force Awakens - Shattered Empire (2015) #1}} |pages=20 |upc=759606081998 |timeline=[[4 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Shattered Empire'' 1 to [[4 ABY]]. |series=*[[Journey to Star Wars: The Force Awakens|Journey to ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']] **''[[Star Wars: Shattered Empire]]'' |issue=1 }} '''''Shattered Empire'' 1''' is the first issue of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Shattered Empire]]'', published by [[Marvel Comics]]. The issue was written by [[Greg Rucka]], penciled by [[Marco Checchetto]], and published on [[September 9]], [[2015]]. The story is set during and immediately after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. ==Publisher's summary== ''For the first time in the new ''Star Wars'' canon, journey with us into the time after the end of ''Return of the Jedi''! Writer Greg Rucka (''PUNISHER'', ''WOLVERINE'', ''Gotham Central'') and artist Marco Checchetto (''AVENGERS WORLD'', ''PUNISHER'') take us past the destruction of the second Death Star into the chaos of a Shattered Empire''. ==Opening crawl== {{OpeningCrawl |name=SHATTERED EMPIRE
Part I |text=It is the final moments of the BATTLE OF ENDOR. Amidst the stars about the Forest Moon, Rebel forces have engaged the evil Galactic Empire in a desperate, final confrontation, hoping to end the tyrannical rule of Emperor Palpatine and bring peace to a wearied and battered galaxy. But the Rebel Fleet has fallen into a trap. The second DEATH STAR is fully operational, and on Endor's moon, the energy shield protecting it still stands. What was to be a moment of triumph now teeters on the brink of disaster. Now, rebel pilots have engaged Imperial forces in furious dogfights, frantically trying to protect the Rebellion's capital ships, and to buy enough time to rescue victory from the jaws of defeat....}} ==Plot summary== In the final moments of the [[Battle of Endor]], [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] escorts [[Gold Leader]] during the attack on the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]]'s main reactor. Green Four ([[Shara Bey]]) intercepts a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] escaping from the Death Star, nearly shooting down [[Luke Skywalker]] before confirming his identity. With the battle station destroyed, Bey and the other surviving pilots return to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Rebel fleet]], and are then shuttled to [[Endor]], where the Rebellion is celebrating its victory with the native [[Ewok]]s. Bey seeks out and finds her husband, [[Kes Dameron]], and they spend the night together in a hut before Dameron is called out to [[Assault on an Imperial outpost|another mission]] to destroy an [[Imperial outpost (Endor)|Imperial holdout]] on the far side of the moon. Bey volunteers as the mission's pilot, and as Dameron and the [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinders]] unit start their attack, he mentions that he was thinking they should find a nice planet and build a house. Bey questions his timing of such a proposal in the midst of a battle, and worries as the strike team is inside the base for a long time. As they emerge, [[Han Solo]] announces that the computers in the outpost contain a lot of data and communications, including details of many Imperial plans, and that "It's not over yet." ==Development== The [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Shattered Empire]]'' was first announced on [[March 10]], [[2015]] as part of the ''[[Journey to Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' series of novels, comics, and other books leading up to the [[December 18]], 2015 release of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].{{SW|url=news/journey-to-star-wars-the-force-awakens-publishing-program-coming-fall-2015|text="Journey to ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''" Publishing Program Coming Fall 2015}} ''Shattered Empire'' was announced as the title of the comic series on [[March 13]], 2015. The announcement was made on [[StarWars.com]] and included the first issue's cover, featuring the main [[original trilogy]] characters from the final scene of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].{{SW|url=news/journey-to-star-wars-the-force-awakens-shattered-empire-1-from-marvel-sneak-peek|text=Journey to ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''
